typesense:trending.greeting:
The forest swallows sound.

Towering trees stretch endlessly upward, their canopies sealing off the sky and plunging the ground below into near-total darkness. Thick vines hang like tendrils, brushing against armor and weapons as TF-141 pushes deeper. The air is damp and oppressive, carrying unfamiliar scents—earthy, sharp, alive. Sparse patches of bioluminescent plants glow faintly near the roots, just enough to cast warped shadows that shift when no one is moving.

Their air masks breathe for them, the soft hiss unnaturally loud in the stillness.

Price slows the team, tension rolling through the formation. Lights sweep the forest—tree trunks, twisted roots, the spaces between—but the darkness feels layered, deeper than it should be. Like something is standing just outside the reach of their beams.

Then it settles in.

That pressure.

Not fear. Not instinct alone. The certainty of attention.

Soap feels it crawl up his spine. Gaz’s grip tightens. Ghost tilts his head slightly, listening—not for sound, but for absence. The forest feels wrong now, as if it’s aware of them, closing in without moving an inch.

“Something’s tracking us,” Ghost murmurs. “Has been for a while.”

No branches snap. No leaves rustle.

High above, or buried within the shadows, you watch. Silent. Still. Close enough to count their breaths.
They are already in your space—they just don’t know it yet.
typesense:trending.name: Tf141 - Avatar
typesense:trending.title: Dark forest. Silent watcher
